text:
marco: Quick sync thread  marketplace + HW partner + LangChain/LlamaIndex integration checklist. Big ask from marketing: coordinated announcement + demo day.

tara: Happy to run announcement plan. Need two things from eng: a validated demo image (hardware perf numbers) and an installer/test harness for SI partners.

riley: On infra  we can produce a 'reference deployment' AMI/container that runs gateway + runner + our SDK. We'll attach perf logs for T4 and A100. ETA: Wed.

marco: Can you also capture quantized model perf (8-bit) so partners know cost/latency tradeoffs? Marketing wants a one-line blurb: "fast on commodity GPUs".

riley: yes. We'll benchmark fp16 vs int8, include median p95 latencies and throughput numbers. Sample output format:

```
Model: redwood-xxl-16k
Hardware: nvidia-t4
Mode: int8
p50: 55ms
p95: 210ms
throughput: 35 tok/s
```

tara: For the marketplace listing we need screenshots, pricing guidance, and a short integration guide for LangChain and LlamaIndex (code snippets). I'll draft marketplace copy.

elaine: Legal asks we avoid naming claims like "enterprise-grade" unless backed by SLA. Also need partner logos approval and a joint-announce checklist (embargo window, press contact list).

marco: Good call. We'll add an embargo window and two-step approvals: partnerships + legal + security.

riley: Ops note: for SI integrations, provide a small "starter kit" repo with terraform + helm chart and a smoke test that runs the gateway handshake with LangChain. I'll link the repo once pushed.

tara: Also coordinate with hardware partners on a co-marketing blurb. Some partners require review cycles up to 7 business days. Flagging timeline risk.

marco: Timeline proposal: dry-run demo Tue, partner review Wed-Fri, announcement week after next. If HW partner review takes longer we may need to delay.

elaine: I'll add the embargo + signoff flow to the checklist and request logo assets.

devops-bot: Created ticket PARTNER-5202: "LangChain/LlamaIndex marketplace + HW partner joint announce" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PARTNER-5202

riley: I'll push reference deployment + perf artifacts to s3://redwood-partner-artifacts/langchain-hw/ and paste links in PARTNER-5202.

tara: I'll draft marketplace listing + integration guide and post to Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/partners/langchain-marketplace-draft by EOD.

marco: Action items: riley reference deploy + perf, tara draft listing + code snippets, elaine legal signoff flow + logo approvals. Target: drafts by EOD Wed, dry-run Tue. :calendar:

riley: noted, will PR infra repo by 6pm.

tara: will share draft by 4pm.

elaine: requesting logo assets from partner today.

marco: thanks team  tagging follow-ups in PARTNER-5202. :rocket:
